name: Intoxalock
desc:
Bilingual Recovery Associate | $18.00 - $23.00+/hr (base + uncapped bonus) | Inbound/Outbound, Collections
Company: Intoxalock (Mindr)
Industry: Substance Use Safety / Ignition Interlock Device Compliance
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be helping customers who use ignition interlock devices stay compliant and on track with their payments, in both English and Spanish. That means answering inbound calls and texts, reaching out proactively about payment plans or overdue balances, and following up consistently on any promises to pay or settlements. It's part customer service, part collections, but the company frames it as supportive rather than punitive, helping people stay accountable without judgment. You'd need to think on your feet, listen closely to what's actually going on with each customer, and work toward resolution that keeps them in the program
assessment: Expect a basic assessment, a typing test, and a home internet speed test, since the posting doesn't state otherwise.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: Associate degree or equivalent work experience
Required Experience: Fluency in both English and Spanish is required. 2+ years of customer service, collections, or sales experience is strongly preferred
Preferred Experience: Not specified beyond required and strongly preferred qualifications
Required Skills:
Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish, verbal and written
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Strong listening skills to understand customer needs and drive resolution
Ability to multitask in a fast-paced call center environment
High motivation to meet department goals
Ability to maintain confidentiality with sensitive information
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
A bilingual participant with 2+ years of customer service, collections, or sales experience
Someone who is naturally persistent and comfortable following up on payment plans or balances
Someone who wants real uncapped earning potential tied to performance
Someone who can approach a collections-adjacent role with empathy rather than pressure tactics
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone who is not fluent in both English and Spanish, this is a hard requirement
Anyone without 2+ years of relevant customer service, collections, or sales experience
Anyone uncomfortable with the collections and retention aspect of the role, even though it's framed supportively
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Bilingual (English/Spanish)
Collections
Customer retention
Account resolution
Payment plans and settlements
Inbound and outbound calls
Problem-solving
Compliance support
Multitasking
Call center experience
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your experience in customer service, collections, or sales, and how it prepared you for this role.
Walk us through how you'd handle a customer who is behind on payments and feeling defensive about it.
What's your comfort level conducting business conversations in both English and Spanish?
How do you stay organized following up on multiple promise-to-pay agreements at once?
Describe a time you had to find a resolution that worked for both the customer and the company's goals.
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $18.00 to $23.00+ per hour, made up of base pay plus uncapped performance-based bonus
Shift: Full-time, Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM CST
Benefits: Not detailed in the posting, confirm during the recruiter screen. Recognized as a 2025 Top Workplace and 2026 Top Workplace for Working Parents
Equipment Provided: Yes, all equipment is provided
Felony Friendly?: Not stated
Drug Test: Not stated
Notes: This is a strong match for a bilingual participant who wants genuine uncapped earning potential and real career stability, since this is a permanent work-from-home position, not seasonal. The company's Top Workplace for Working Parents recognition is a nice detail to highlight for participants balancing family responsibilities. The role does carry a collections component, so it's worth setting expectations that persistence and follow-through matter just as much as customer service skills here.
Career Pathway: Bilingual Recovery Associate → Senior Recovery Associate → Team Lead or Retention Operations Specialist
